Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background

Class MenuBackgroundChoice

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background.MenuBackgroundChoice
public final class MenuBackgroundChoice extends Object
What a MenuBackgroundResolver decided for one menu.

Glyphs are written as in guis.yml: a name from backgrounds.glyphs, the characters themselves (a unicode escape written as text works too), or none. They get the shared backgrounds.color and backgrounds.reset, exactly like a rule's glyphs, so an add-on can ship textures that server owners place with their own pack's spacing.

Since:
1.15.0
